text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a concentrated spike of Xid and ECC errors originating from rack6 this morning. 6 different nodes threw soft ECC corrections and 3 produced Xid 31 in the last 45m. Suspect a bad batch of cards (serials start with 6K8).
infra-bot: [ALERT] 1962109810: gpu-monitor: rack6 nodes: 6/48 reporting ECC > 0; rolling alert created.
devin: Can you paste the node IDs and sample logs? quick grep is fine.
maria: nodes: infer-r6-n[03,07,09,12,21,29]. sample from infer-r6-n09: ```kernel: NVRM: Xid (31) at 0x... PID 4128 pcie link error nvlink 0a: gpu 0``` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=serial,ecc.mode.active,ecc.errors.uncorrected --format=csv` shows serials: 6K8A1234, 6K8A1235, 6K8B9988 etc (multiple with 6K8 prefix). temps are normal (70-78C).
sam: Thanks. Cross-referenced with procurement/RMA sheet — 6K8 prefix was from last quarter's lot from vendor X, ship date 2025-11. There's an open limited warranty but not a bulk RMA yet. I also see two of those serials were returned once for intermittent Xids in Jan and marked fixed.
devin: Quick triage plan: 1) cordon + drain the 6 affected nodes, 2) swap workloads to spare pool (dedicated-pool-3) 3) collect full `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi -q` and run `gpu-diagnostic --extended` 4) snapshot NVML logs and upload to ticket.
maria: started cordon on n09 and n21. draining inference pods now — some batch jobs will be rescheduled.
lisa: Dropping capacity note: dedicated-pool-3 is at 78% util; if we keep draining more nodes we risk throttling some latency SLAs for production. Suggest spinning up 4 temporary STS instances in us-west-2 to soak non-critical jobs while we triage. Cost wise it's cheaper than emergency RMA downtime.
devin: Agreed. I'll ask infra-autoscaler to provision 4 g4dn-like instances in on-demand until we finalize RMA.
sam: On the RMA side I can open a cluster-level claim referencing this serial range and attach the logs. Vendor response SLA is 5 business days; escalate path if manufacturing lot confirmed. Also recommend isolating nodes by PCIe topology — same backplane on rack6?
maria: rack6 uses backplane revision B2. Two of the failing cards are in adjacent PCI slots (slot 1/2) on same host. Pattern could be either batch-level or local power/connector stress.
ton y: @maria @devi n — allocate oncall to run thermal/power stress test tonight (post-22:00). I'll schedule a maintenance window for 23:00-01:00 and inform SRE. Also will open ticket INF-2026-731 referencing cluster, serial prefixes, and initial logs.
lisa: Noted. Ops note for scheduling: avoid rolling any dedicated customer canaries between 23:30-00:30 (we have a canary test then).
devin: For diagnostics, run this on the node before full drain: ```sudo nvidia-smi --gpu-reset -i 0 && sudo ./vendor_diag.sh --serial 6K8A1234 --nvlink --pci-stress 600``` capture exit codes. If GPU reset consistently fails -> escalate to RMA immediate.
maria: Ran vendor_diag on n03 and it completed but returned 3 soft ECC corrections flagged in the vendor log. Uploading to INF-2026-731 now.
sam: Given the repeated failures on the lot, recommendation: 1) blacklist serial prefix 6K8 for auto-schedule into capacity pools, 2) prioritize replacement for nodes with >=2 Xid events, 3) open procurement hold for that vendor lot until resolved.
lisa: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note for enterprise teams summarizing impact and mitigation (no customer data exposure, rolling mitigation in place).
ton y: Action items: maria -> full logs + heap dumps to INF-2026-731 (assigned), devin -> temp capacity + diagnostics script and runlist, sam -> open RMA cluster claim and tag procurement, lisa -> enterprise comms draft, tony -> schedule maintenance and oncall rotation.
maria: will attach `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q` outputs and an anonymized sampled stack trace.
devin: I'll keep autoscaler and billing in the loop (estimate cost delta ~ $1.8k/day if we keep 4 on-demand instances for triage).
sam: Filing RMA claim now. If vendor confirms manufacturing variance we'll request priority exchange and coordinate crate pickup.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll keep updating thread with new Xid counts. current rack6 ECC rate trend: +220% vs baseline last 7 days.
infra-bot: [UPDATE] 1962110070: rack6 Xid count now 12 events in 90 minutes.
maria: night ops will run extended PCIe/power stress and we'll reconvene in morning 09:30 to decide on full rack quarantine or per-card replacements.
lisa: Adding note to calendar 09:30 triage meeting. :thumbsup:
